Anthropic opens life sciences research program with free access to internal AI models
gb.description: University, nonprofit and government research teams can apply for 8–12 weeks of collaboration with Anthropic scientists, with applications open for approximately 14 days Anthropic has opened applications for a new life sciences guest investigator program, offering selected researchers the opportunity to work directly with its scientific teams and use internal AI models and research tools at no cost. The program is aimed at principal investigators and research groups at universities, nonprofit research organizations and government laboratories. Successful applicants will collaborate with Anthropic researchers over eight to 12 weeks, using the company’s AI models and internal research harnesses to investigate scientific questions and produce findings, analyses or tools. Applications opened on October 22, 2026, and will remain open for approximately 14 days. Anthropic is seeking proposals across five fields: causal human biology, structural and computational molecular biology, medicinal chemistry, drug discovery and clinical science. Rather than offering unrestricted access to its technology, Anthropic is asking researchers to identify a specific problem that would benefit from working with its team. Proposals must demonstrate how a useful research output could be produced within the collaboration period. Anthropic seeks research results within 12 weeks The company is prioritizing projects that can deliver preliminary discoveries, answers to open scientific questions, open-source datasets or other public research resources. Anthropic acknowledges that validating scientific discoveries can take considerably longer than the program allows. Applicants are therefore not expected to resolve complex research questions completely, but must make a credible case for producing preliminary evidence within eight to 12 weeks. Some projects may qualify for extensions beyond the initial collaboration period. Nathan Frey, who works in life sciences at Anthropic, emphasized the role of researchers in directing the work in a LinkedIn post announcing the program. "We want humans to remain at the center of scientific discovery, deciding what questions to pursue, and how to pursue them," he wrote. The arrangement gives participating research teams access to Anthropic’s internal expertise and research systems, with the company responsible for running the models and harnesses needed for the agreed projects. Researchers retain data rights as Anthropic plans open-source outputs Anthropic says guest investigators will retain the rights to their data throughout the collaboration, as well as the rights to any independent follow-on research. The company plans to publish the resulting research outputs jointly with participants and open-source accompanying data and code, allowing other researchers to build on the work. Importantly, applicants are not required to hand over their research datasets to Anthropic, either during the application process or throughout the collaboration. The company specifically instructs applicants to include only publicly available information in their proposals. The guest investigator program adds another route for scientific researchers to work with Anthropic’s technology. Its existing AI for Science initiative provides Claude credits to support scientific research, while its Life Sciences Verification Program offers eligible scientists access to its most capable publicly available models for biology. The new program differs by offering direct collaboration with Anthropic’s research team and the use of internal models and harnesses for defined research projects. Who can apply Applicants must be researchers affiliated with an academic institution, government laboratory or nonprofit research organization. Graduate students and other research trainees can apply on behalf of their principal investigator and act as the main point of contact. Proposals must explain the research problem, why the applicant is qualified to investigate it, the anticipated outcomes and why direct collaboration with Anthropic would provide a particular advantage. Anthropic estimates that the application form takes less than 30 minutes to complete. Applications are available through Anthropic’s Guest Investigator Program, with selected projects expected to run for eight to 12 weeks. Đề rèn luyện Toán 11 - Đề số 02: Dãy số, Cấp số cộng và Cấp số nhân
vn.description: Bài viết tổng hợp bộ câu hỏi trắc nghiệm rèn luyện thuộc chuyên đề Dãy số, Cấp số cộng và Cấp số nhân môn Toán lớp 11. Các bài tập được phân loại từ mức độ nhận biết, thông hiểu đến vận dụng thực tế như tính lãi kép, tính tăng trưởng dân số và các bài toán mô hình hình học. PHẦN I. CÂU HỎI TRẮC NGHIỆM NHIỀU PHƯƠNG ÁN LỰA CHỌN Câu 1. Chu vi một đa giác là \(158\text{ cm}\), số đo các cạnh của nó lập thành một cấp số cộng với công sai \(d = 3\text{ cm}\). Biết cạnh lớn nhất là \(44\text{ cm}\). Số cạnh của đa giác đó là? A. 3. B. 4. C. 5. D. 6. Câu 2. Một băng giấy được cuộn 600 vòng quanh một lõi bìa cứng đường kính 2cm, tạo thành cuộn giấy có đường kính 10cm. Giả sử băng giấy được tạo thành từ 600 đường tròn đồng tâm có đường kính cách đều nhau từ 2 đến 10cm. Khi đó chiều dài băng giấy được tính theo mét là A. \(36\pi\). B. \(45\pi\). C. \(60\pi\). D. \(32\pi\). Câu 3. Cho dãy số \(u_1 = 1\); \(u_n = u_{n-1} + 2, \forall n \ge 2\). Kết quả nào đúng? A. \(u_5 = 9\). B. \(u_3 = 7\). C. \(u_2 = 2\). D. \(u_6 = 13\). Câu 4. Cho cấp số nhân \((u_n)\) có \(u_1 = -2\) và công bội \(q = 3\). Số hạng \(u_2\) là: A. \(u_2 = -18\). B. \(u_2 = 6\). C. \(u_2 = 18\). D. \(u_2 = -6\). Câu 5. Trong các dãy số \((u_n)\) cho bởi số hạng tổng quát \(u_n\) sau, dãy số nào là một cấp số nhân? A. \(u_n = \frac{1}{3^{n-2}}\) B. \(u_n = \frac{1}{3^n} - 1\) C. \(u_n = n + \frac{1}{3}\) D. \(u_n = n^2 - \frac{1}{3}\) Câu 6. Cho cấp số nhân \(\frac{1}{2}; \frac{1}{4}; \frac{1}{8}; \dots; \frac{1}{4096}\). Hỏi số \(\frac{1}{4096}\) là số hạng thứ mấy trong cấp số nhân đã cho? A. 11. B. 12. C. 10. D. 13. Câu 7. Xác định \(x\) dương để \(2x - 3\); \(x\); \(2x + 3\) lập thành cấp số nhân. A. \(x = 3\). B. \(x = \sqrt{3}\). C. \(x = \pm \sqrt{3}\). D. Không tồn tại x thỏa mãn. Câu 8. Một cấp số nhân có 6 số hạng, số hạng đầu bằng 2 và số hạng thứ sáu bằng 486. Tìm công bội \(q\) của cấp số nhân đã cho. A. \(q = 3\). B. \(q = -3\). C. \(q = 2\). D. \(q = -2\). Câu 9. Cho cấp số nhân có các số hạng lần lượt là \(x; 12; y; 192\). Mệnh đề nào sau đây là đúng? A. \(x = 1; y = 144\). B. \(x = 2; y = 72\). C. \(x = 3; y = 48\). D. \(x = 4; y = 36\). Câu 10. Cho cấp số nhân \((u_n)\) có \(u_1 = 3\) và \(q = -2\). Số 192 là số hạng thứ mấy của cấp số nhân đã cho? A. Số hạng thứ 5. B. Số hạng thứ 6. C. Số hạng thứ 7. D. Số hạng thứ 8. Câu 11. Một dãy số được xác định bởi \(u_1 = -4\) và \(u_n = -\frac{1}{2} u_{n-1}, n \ge 2\). Số hạng tổng quát \(u_n\) của dãy số đó là: A. \(u_n = 2^{n-1}\) B. \(u_n = (-2)^{n-1}\) C. \(u_n = -4(2^{-n+1})\) D. \(u_n = -4\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n-1}\) Câu 12. Xác định số hạng đầu và công bội của cấp số nhân \((u_n)\) có \(u_4 - u_2 = 54\) và \(u_5 - u_3 = 108\). A. \(u_1 = 3\) và \(q = 2\). B. \(u_1 = 9\) và \(q = 2\). C. \(u_1 = 9\) và \(q = -2\). D. \(u_1 = 3\) và \(q = -2\). Câu 13. Tính tổng tất cả các số hạng của một cấp số nhân có số hạng đầu là \(\frac{1}{2}\), số hạng thứ tư là 32 và số hạng cuối là 2048? A. \(\frac{1365}{2}\). B. \(\frac{5416}{2}\). C. \(\frac{5461}{2}\). D. \(\frac{21845}{2}\). Câu 14. Người ta dự định xây một tòa tháp 11 tầng theo cấu trúc diện tích mặt sàn của tầng trên bằng ba phần tư diện tích mặt sàn của tầng ngay bên dưới, biết diện tích mặt sàn thấp nhất của tháp là \(36\text{ m}^2\). Hỏi số lượng gạch hoa cần dùng để lát nền nhà gần với con số nào sau đây biết rằng toàn bộ nền nhà được lát gạch cỡ \(30 \times 30\text{ cm}\)? A. 1533. B. 1560. C. 1529. D. 1555. Câu 15. Một người gửi số tiền 100 triệu đồng vào một ngân hàng với lãi suất \(7\%/\text{năm}\). Biết rằng nếu người đó không rút tiền ra thì cứ sau mỗi năm số tiền lãi được nhập vào vốn ban đầu (người ta gọi đó là lãi kép). Giả sử trong khoảng thời gian gửi người gửi không rút tiền ra và lãi suất không thay đổi, hỏi sau 10 năm thì tổng số tiền cả vốn lẫn lãi mà người gửi nhận được gần với số tiền nào trong các số tiền dưới đây? A. 196 715 000 đồng. B. 196 716 000 đồng. C. 183 845 000 đồng. D. 183 846 000 đồng. Câu 16. Tỷ lệ tăng dân số của tỉnh M là \(1,2\%\). Biết rằng số dân của tỉnh M hiện nay là 2 triệu người. in.title: H1 Corrective Rally Into Key Resistance
in.description: Gold is trading around 4,011, recovering modestly after last week’s decline pushed price toward the 3,975 area. The rebound has been helped by softer oil prices and bargain buying, but the broader macro environment remains restrictive. The Federal Reserve begins its October meeting today and is widely expected to hold rates unchanged, while persistent inflation keeps another rate increase later this year firmly in play. Technical View The H1 structure remains bearish. Gold continues to trade beneath the main descending trendline, while the sequence from the 4,19x high has produced clear bearish displacement and successive structural breaks. Price is currently holding inside the 4,004–4,020 Current Reaction Zone. A small CHoCH around the recent lows shows that sellers are temporarily losing momentum, but this is not enough to confirm a broader reversal. The chart projection favors a corrective rally first. The most important upside area is 4,055–4,070 Key Resistance, where the descending trendline and previous breakdown structure create a strong bearish confluence. This is the zone where the next directional decision becomes more meaningful. Key Zones 4,199.502 — Major Resistance 4,174–4,188 — Higher Supply 4,124–4,142 — Major Supply Zone 4,055–4,070 — Key Resistance / Main Bearish POI 4,004–4,020 — Current Reaction Zone 3,974.902 — Major Support / Downside Objective Trading Plan Sell Priority The main scenario is to allow Gold to recover from the 4,004–4,020 Current Reaction Zone toward 4,055–4,070 Key Resistance. I do not want to chase downside around current price. The condition is a clear H1 rejection or failure to establish sustained acceptance above 4,070 and the descending trendline. If sellers confirm from this area, I will favor a rotation back toward 4,020, followed by another test of the lower structure. A failure to hold that reaction area would reopen the path toward 3,974.902 Major Support. The projected sequence is: 4,004–4,020 hold → corrective rally into 4,055–4,070 → bearish rejection → renewed downside toward 3,974.902. Invalidation The immediate bearish thesis weakens if Gold establishes sustained H1 acceptance above 4,070 and breaks through the descending trendline. That would suggest the recovery is developing beyond a simple corrective move and would shift attention toward the 4,124–4,142 Major Supply Zone. Until that occurs, rallies remain corrective within the broader bearish H1 structure. Mason View Gold is attempting to stabilize after an extended decline, but the broader H1 trend has not changed. The key mistake here would be confusing a reaction from support with a confirmed reversal. 4,004–4,020 is the current recovery base, but 4,055–4,070 is where the real test begins. If sellers defend that resistance and the descending trendline, the cleaner path remains a renewed rotation toward 3,974.902 Major Support. For now, the focus is simple: let price retrace into resistance, then judge whether sellers are ready to resume control.

bd.title: New electrification index shows China out front as US risks stalling and Europe's policies outpace delivery
bd.description: LONDON, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- China is pulling ahead on electrification, while the US risks losing momentum and some of Europe's biggest economies have yet to translate policy into delivery, according to new analysis. The Electrification Competitiveness Index assesses progress in 16 countries, measuring electrification delivery on the ground and the conditions needed for further progress. These enabling and deployment factors indicate how ready economies are for businesses to electrify operations. The analysis exposes a widespread implementation gap, with policy and other enabling conditions ahead of electrification deployment across most countries. The Index, developed by We Mean Business Coalition with support from RMI, assesses Australia, Brazil, China, Ethiopia, France, Germany, India, Indonesia, Italy, the Philippines, Poland, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, UK and US. Electrification, combined with clean power, can reduce fossil fuel reliance, strengthen energy security, reduce exposure to volatile fuel prices, support growth and productivity, cut emissions and improve health through cleaner air. It will be a key focus at COP31. Countries are grouped in four categories: Solid foundation - China, France, Spain: relatively strong deployment and strong enablers. China has the highest deployment score, backed by coordinated grid investment, industrial policy and incentives. France and Spain score well on grid performance and clean power shares. In all three countries, electricity prices are more competitive against gas than in most other economies assessed. Potential for take-off - Germany, India, Italy, Poland, UK: enablers higher than deployment. The UK has the largest gap between policy and delivery. Electricity costs around five times as much as gas per unit of energy for UK industry, while Germany faces a grid connection backlog of hundreds of gigawatts. Risk of stalling - US, Australia, Brazil, Ethiopia, South Korea: deployment sits at/above the halfway mark with enablers below the median. In the US federal policy reversals and grid bottlenecks risk slowing momentum. The US has more than 2TW of generation and storage waiting in interconnection queues, compared with roughly 1.3TW of existing generating capacity. Early-stage adoption - Indonesia, the Philippines and South Africa: below the halfway marks on deployment and enablers. Clean power accounts for 18% of generation in Indonesia and South Africa and 23% in the Philippines, while grid investment in all three is below 0.4% of GDP, against 0.65% average across the sample. Report & full release: https://www.wemeanbusinesscoalition.org/blog/new-index-maps-electrification-competitiveness-of-countries/

pg.title: PNG University of Technology Online Study Program : APPLY NOW
pg.description: The Papua New Guinea University of Technology (PNGUOT) is inviting applications from suitably qualified Papua New Guineans for its 2027 academic year online programmes. The opportunity is open to eligible applicants, including non-school leavers who wish to pursue university studies through online learning. Available programmes cover business, communication, property studies, applied mathematics and construction management. Available Online Programmes Bachelor of Business in Accountancy Bachelor of Business in Applied Economics Bachelor of Business in Information Technology Bachelor of Business in Management Bachelor of Arts in Communication for Development Bachelor of Property Studies Bachelor of Science in Applied Mathematics Bachelor of Construction Management Most programmes have a duration of four years. The Bachelor of Construction Management requires a diploma in Building, Architecture, Civil Engineering or Civil Engineering-related equivalent qualification from a recognised tertiary institution. Eligibility Applicants must be Papua New Guineans with a Grade 12 Higher School Certificate or an equivalent qualification and meet the minimum entry requirements for their chosen programme. Entry requirements vary by programme and may include minimum grades in Mathematics A or B, English or Applied English, Economics, Accounting, Business Studies, Information and Communication Technology (ICT), Geography, Legal Studies, Chemistry or Biology. Applicants should check the specific academic requirements for their preferred programme before applying. Tuition Fees The advertised tuition fee is K5,345 per course per year for the Bachelor of Business in Accountancy. The other listed programmes are advertised at K5,345 per year. The university notes that fees may be subject to slight changes. All fees must be paid directly into the university account specified in the official announcement. Applicants should confirm the correct payment details with the university before making any payment. ae.title: UAE car insurance prices have peaked after two years of rises – experts say stability is here
ae.description: Dubai: Insurance industry experts say vehicle insurance prices have stabilised, following two years of consecutive increases - with the market now believed to have reached its peak. They said, on the sidelines of the 21st Annual Gulf Insurance Forum, which kicked off in Dubai yesterday, that part of the increase in average prices was due to the entry of new models of vehicles in the local market, specifically vehicles for which insurance companies do not have performance records because they are ‘new’. They explained that insurance premium rates for conventional cars range between 2.5% and 3% of the vehicle's value, while for Chinese and electric cars they range between 3.5% and 3.75%. Peak prices In detail, the CEO of Liva Insurance - UAE and Bahrain office, Adal Sarour, said that car insurance prices in the local market have witnessed an increase over the past two years at rates ranging between 10% and 15% on an annual basis, noting that the market has now reached the peak of those prices, with expectations that the coming period will witness limited increases, and not at the large rates of the past. Sarour explained that part of the increase in average prices is due to the entry of new models of vehicles into the local market, especially vehicles for which, insurance companies do not have performance records. He added that the market share of these cars has increased from about 2% five years ago to about 20% currently, with expectations that it will reach about 50% during the next three to four years. He considered that the weather conditions in 2024 constituted an exceptional event for insurance companies, especially the car sector, as these companies bore a large part of the claims, noting that the vehicle insurance sector witnessed an increase in average prices. Sarour explained that supply chains were affected by the repercussions of the COVID-19 pandemic, as well as geopolitical tensions, which led to difficulty in providing spare parts of the appropriate quality, in addition to increased maintenance costs. Price stability For his part, Anas Mustarihi, founder of the eSanad insurance platform, said that after the remarkable increases recorded in car insurance prices during 2024, the market began to move towards stability and relative decline during 2025 and 2026, exceeding the previous rates of increase that ranged between 5% and 7%. He added that some insurance companies have reduced prices for certain segments of drivers, based on their accident-free driving records, as a reward for compliant drivers. Mustarihi explained that insurance premium rates for conventional cars range between 2.5% and 3% of the vehicle's value, while for Chinese and electric cars they range between 3.5% and 3.75%. He noted that Chinese and electric cars accounted for about 40% of new car sales in 2024. For his part, Jihad Fitrouni, CEO of UIS Management, an insurance risk management company, said that the exceptional weather conditions in 2024 brought about changes in the vehicle insurance and accident management market, predicting that vehicle insurance policy prices would stabilise in the coming period. He pointed out that car insurance and health insurance are among the largest insurance portfolios in insurance companies, indicating that the percentage of the health insurance and car insurance portfolios in some companies reaches levels exceeding 50% to 60%. In the same context, Farid Lutfi, Secretary General of the Gulf Insurance Federation and the Emirates Insurance Federation, confirmed that the pricing of car insurance policies is linked to the driver’s traffic record, so that the insurance company can reduce the value of the policy for a person who has a clean record. He said that vehicle insurance prices have increased over the past two years, noting that policy pricing should take into account several factors, including the driver and the type of vehicle. He explained that spare parts, repair costs, and the quality of workshops and garages remain the main factors that govern the rise or fall of insurance costs. Lutfi added that the insurance sector relies primarily on the processes and statistics of large numbers of accidents and daily changing data, noting at the same time that some Chinese car models sometimes face challenges related to the availability of spare parts. Annual Gulf Insurance Forum The 21st Annual Gulf Insurance Forum kicked off in Dubai yesterday, with the participation of 200 CEOs and insurance and reinsurance experts from 25 countries. Over two days, the forum will discuss several topics, most notably those that focus on the transformations that artificial intelligence can bring about in the insurance industry, as well as cyber risks and artificial intelligence risks in the sector, in addition to several other topics including the growing role of alternative capital, and the contribution of capital markets through disaster bonds and insurance-linked securities. The forum will also discuss the pivotal role of actuarial departments and functions, and translate the topics that the forum will address into a strategic agenda for insurance sector leaders.

sa.title: لقاح جديد لسرطان الجلد يخفض خطر عودة المرض أو الوفاة بنسبة 42%
sa.description: كشفت نتائج المرحلة الثالثة من تجربة سريرية دولية عن نجاح لقاح شخصي جديد يعتمد على تقنية الحمض النووي الريبي المرسال (mRNA) في خفض خطر عودة سرطان الجلد «الميلانوما» أو الوفاة بنسبة 42%، عند استخدامه إلى جانب العلاج المناعي المعتاد، في نتائج تجاوزت توقعات الباحثين وفتحت آفاقاً جديدة لعلاج السرطان. وجرى الكشف عن النتائج خلال مؤتمر الجمعية الأوروبية لعلم الأورام الطبية لعام 2026، على لسان الباحثة الرئيسية في التجربة، اختصاصية الأورام جورجينا لونغ من معهد الميلانوما الأسترالي، وفقاً لموقع «ساينس أليرت».واعتبرت لونغ أن النتائج تمثل تحولاً مهماً في علاج السرطان، من خلال تطوير لقاحات تستهدف الخصائص الجينية الفريدة للأورام لدى كل مريض، بما يساعد الجهاز المناعي على التعرف على الخلايا السرطانية ومهاجمتها.من جانبه، وصف اختصاصي الأورام روبرت فوندرهايد، الرئيس المنتخب للجمعية الأمريكية لأبحاث السرطان، الذي لم يشارك في التجربة، النتائج بأنها من أبرز الإنجازات في مجال أبحاث السرطان، بحسب تصريحات نقلتها صحيفة «نيويورك تايمز».كيف يعمل اللقاح؟وطورت شركتا «موديرنا» و«ميرك» اللقاح بهدف منع عودة سرطان الميلانوما بعد استئصال الورم جراحياً، إذ يعتمد على تحليل التسلسل الجيني للورم وتحديد الطفرات التي تميزه عن الخلايا السليمة، ثم تصميم لقاح خاص بكل مريض لتدريب جهازه المناعي على التعرف على الخلايا السرطانية.ويستخدم اللقاح تقنية الرنا المرسال لتوجيه خلايا الجسم إلى إنتاج مؤشرات جزيئية تساعد الجهاز المناعي على تحديد الخلايا المستهدفة، فيما يعمل العلاج المناعي المصاحب على تعطيل الآليات التي تستخدمها الأورام للتهرب من الاستجابة المناعية.نتائج مشجعةوشملت التجربة السريرية، المعروفة باسم «INTerpath-001»، أكثر من 1100 مريض في 157 مركزاً حول العالم، وأكدت نتائجها الاتجاه الإيجابي الذي أظهرته المرحلة الثانية من التجارب، المنشورة عام 2024.وأظهرت النتائج انخفاض خطر عودة المرض أو الوفاة بنسبة 42% لدى المرضى الذين تلقوا اللقاح مع العلاج المناعي، مقارنة بمن تلقوا العلاج المناعي وحده.كما بلغ انخفاض الخطر 58% في تحليل شمل المرضى الذين ظلوا خالين من السرطان بعد مرور ستة أشهر على بدء العلاج.ورغم النتائج الواعدة، لم يحصل اللقاح حتى الآن على الموافقات اللازمة لإتاحته للمرضى في أستراليا أو الولايات المتحدة، إذ لا تزال النتائج تخضع للمراجعة التنظيمية، وهي إجراءات قد تستغرق سنوات بحسب متطلبات كل دولة.وتبرز أهمية هذه النتائج في أستراليا، التي تسجل أحد أعلى معدلات الإصابة بسرطان الجلد عالمياً، مع وفاة شخص بسبب المرض كل ست ساعات تقريباً.آفاق علاجية جديدةويأمل اختصاصي الأورام في معهد الميلانوما الأسترالي أليكس مينزيز أن تفتح هذه التقنية المجال لعلاج المرضى المصابين بمراحل متقدمة من الميلانوما، إلى جانب أنواع أخرى من السرطان لا تستجيب بصورة كافية للعلاجات المناعية الحالية.وتأتي النتائج في وقت أخفقت فيه تجارب عشوائية حديثة للقاحات تعتمد على تقنية الرنا المرسال، استهدفت سرطان القولون والمستقيم وسرطان الرأس والرقبة، في تحقيق انخفاض ملموس في معدلات عودة المرض.وترى لونغ أن الجمع بين اللقاحات المصممة وفق البصمة الجينية لكل ورم والعلاجات المناعية قد يعزز قدرة الجهاز المناعي على اكتشاف الخلايا السرطانية المتبقية والقضاء عليها، مشبهةً الأثر المحتمل لهذه التقنية في علاج السرطان بالتحول الذي أحدثه البريد الإلكتروني في وسائل التواصل.

iq.title: عقب الغارات الأردنية.. سوريا تغلق منفذ نصيب وتوقف حركة المسافرين والتجارة
iq.description: شفق نيوز- دمشق أعلنت الهيئة العامة للمنافذ والجمارك السورية، الثلاثاء، إغلاق منفذ نصيب الحدودي مع الأردن، وتعليق حركة المسافرين والتبادل التجاري بشكل كامل في الاتجاهين، على خلفية التطورات الأمنية التي تشهدها محافظة درعا جنوبي البلاد، عقب غارات جوية أردنية أسفرت عن سقوط قتلى وجرحى من المدنيين. وقالت الهيئة في بيان، إن قرار إغلاق المنفذ جاء "نظراً للأوضاع الراهنة والتطورات الميدانية في محافظة درعا"، مؤكدة أن تعليق حركة العبور يشمل المسافرين والشاحنات التجارية في كلا الاتجاهين، حفاظاً على سلامة المسافرين والعاملين في المنفذ. وأضافت أنها تتابع التطورات الميدانية بصورة مستمرة، وتتخذ الإجراءات اللازمة لضمان سلامة الجميع، دون أن تحدد موعداً لإعادة فتح المنفذ واستئناف الحركة فيه. ويأتي القرار بعد ساعات من تنفيذ سلاح الجو الأردني غارات على مواقع في ريف درعا، أعلنت السلطات الصحية السورية أنها أسفرت عن مقتل خمسة مدنيين، بينهم نساء وأطفال، وإصابة آخرين. وكان الجيش الأردني قد أعلن تنفيذ ضربات جوية استهدفت ما وصفها بأوكار جماعات مسلحة في جنوب سوريا، رداً على هجوم استهدف كنيسة في محافظة الكرك الأردنية، يوم الجمعة الماضي، وأسفر عن مقتل تسعة أشخاص وإصابة العشرات. وأكد الجانب الأردني أن العملية جرت بالتنسيق مع دمشق، غير أن الحكومة السورية نفت وجود أي تنسيق مسبق، معلنة فتح تحقيق في ملابسات الغارات وإجراء اتصالات مباشرة مع عمّان لبحث تداعياتها. ويُعد منفذ نصيب، الذي يقابله معبر جابر على الجانب الأردني، أحد أهم المنافذ البرية السورية، إذ يمثل شرياناً رئيسياً لحركة المسافرين والشاحنات والتبادل التجاري بين سوريا والأردن، فضلاً عن دوره في مرور البضائع العابرة إلى أسواق إقليمية أخرى.

mg.title: FINANCES PUBLIQUES - L’accent mis sur la transparence
mg.description: Le ministre de l’Économie et des Finances renforce la transparence, avec des rapports sous 24 heures, des bilans hebdomadaires et des sanctions. Rapports sous 24 heures, comptes rendus hebdomadaires et rappel à l’ordre strict : face aux exigences de transparence érigées en priorité par l’exécutif, le ministre de l’Économie et des Finances, le Dr Herinjatovo Aimé Ramiarison, a réuni ses équipes le 24 octobre à Anosy pour exiger un engagement accru de chaque agent. La lutte contre la c orruption n’est pas seulement un principe ; c’est une condition sine qua non pour préserver les ressources de l’État. C’est le message fort qu’a adressé le Dr Herinjatovo Aimé Ramiarison aux responsables et agents de son département lors de cette rencontre de cadrage. Dans un secteur où les ressources financent des axes vitaux santé, éducation, infrastructures, les irrégularités et les détournements pèsent directement sur l’efficacité de l’action publique et sur le quotidien des citoyens. Pour s’assurer que les directives se traduisent en actes, le ministère pose de nouveaux jalons organisationnels. Chaque direction générale est désormais invitée à multiplier les échanges internes et à formuler rapidement des propositions concrètes. Surtout, un compte rendu hebdomadaire détaillé sur la situation et les actions entreprises devra être transmis par chaque département. Signalements rapides et sanctions annoncées Autre disposition clé de cette rencontre : la réactivité face aux dysfonctionnements. Les agents ont pour consigne de signaler sans délai tout fait susceptible d’affecter le bon fonctionnement du service. Ces alertes devront être formalisées par un rapport écrit officiel dans un délai maximal de 24 heures. Le ministre l’a rappelé sans ambiguïté : des sanctions s’appliqueront aux personnes impliquées dans des actes de corruption, mais aussi à celles qui manqueraient de respecter les directives internes. Si la rigueur est exigée de tous, l’accompagnement reste de mise. Le Dr Herinjatovo Aimé Ramiarison a réaffirmé sa volonté de soutenir et de protéger les agents intègres dans l’exercice de leurs fonctions, tout en appelant à une mobilisation renforcée des dispositifs existants de réception des plaintes. L’efficacité de cette initiative reposera in fine sur la régularité des contrôles et l’application effective des mesures. Pour l’administration financière, l’enjeu est de taille : transformer durablement les engagements en pratiques concrètes pour consolider la confiance des citoyens envers les institutions. Lucia Rabarijaona

mg.title: MORAMANGA - Ambatovy soutient les projets de développement
mg.description: La commune urbaine de Moramanga a reçu, en avril 2026, 455,14 millions d’ariary de ristournes minières versées par Ambatovy. Ces fonds doivent notamment financer des infrastructures pour améliorer les services municipaux et les conditions de vie des habitants. L’extension du bureau communal, la réhabilitation de la gare routière et la remise en état de plusieurs routes figurent parmi les priorités du maire, Sylvain Rodolphe Ralaiarimalala. La levée, par l’État, de la suspension du versement des redevances minières d’Ambatovy, en vigueur depuis 2022, a permis la reprise des paiements. Au titre de la période allant de septembre 2020 à décembre 2025, l’entreprise a versé 98,26 milliards d’ariary de ristournes, répartis entre les six communes bénéficiaires du district. Selon la réglementation, 30 % de ces fonds sont affectés au fonctionnement et 70 % au financement de projets de développement répondant aux besoins de la population. À Moramanga, l’extension du bureau communal constitue la première priorité. Les locaux actuels ne répondent plus aux besoins des services municipaux, qui comptent plus de 90 agents permanents, auxquels s’ajoutent des employés temporaires. Le manque d’espace et de matériel complique le traitement des demandes des usagers. « L’extension du bureau communal est prioritaire, car elle permettra de mieux servir la population, en toute transparence », explique le maire. L’amélioration des locaux doit également faciliter les démarches administratives et contribuer à réduire les risques de petite corruption. La commune prévoit aussi de réhabiliter la gare routière et plusieurs routes dans deux fokontany. Ces travaux visent à faciliter les déplacements et l’accès aux services, tout en soutenant les activités économiques locales. La collaboration entre Moramanga et Ambatovy comprend également des actions sociales, dans une ville où résident de nombreux salariés de la compagnie minière. Des rencontres trimestrielles réunissant les communes concernées permettent de définir les besoins et les projets prioritaires. Le plan de passation des marchés de la commune a déjà été approuvé et devrait être publié prochainement. Le démarrage des travaux est envisagé dans un délai d’un à deux mois. Par ailleurs, une formation destinée aux maires et à leurs collaborateurs sur la gestion des fonds publics a débuté le 21 octobre à Ambohibary. Elle vise à favoriser une gestion transparente des ressources et des investissements durables, créateurs d’emplois et bénéficiant directement aux habitants. Lucia Rabarijaona

mg.title: TRANSPORT - Les travaux routiers relancent les échanges commerciaux
mg.description: Les routes du Sud et plusieurs infrastructures portuaires figurent au cœur de la troisième phase du programme d’aménagement des corridors et de facilitation du commerce. Prévue pour 2025-2030, elle mobilise 174,65 millions d’unités de compte, soit environ 229,47 millions de dollars, pour améliorer le transport des marchandises et renforcer les échanges régionaux. Parmi les projets annoncés figurent la réhabilitation de la route Bevoay–Morombe, sur environ 78 kilomètres, l’aménagement de la rocade-digue de Fiherenana, longue de 22 kilomètres, ainsi que les ponts de Manombo et de Belalanda, sur la route nationale 9. La rocade-digue doit notamment contribuer à protéger Toliara contre les inondations. L’état des routes influe sur les délais de livraison et les coûts supportés par les transporteurs. Le programme prévoit une réduction de 46 % des coûts d’exploitation des poids lourds à l’horizon 2026. Cette projection reste à vérifier sur le terrain, une fois les infrastructures réalisées et mises en service. Le volet portuaire concerne également Nosy Be, Antsiranana et Vohémar. Des mesures liées à la sûreté portuaire sont prévues, ainsi que la création d’une académie des douanes, d’un centre de métrologie et d’un guichet unique maritime. Le renforcement des échanges entre le port de Toliara et celui de Beira, au Mozambique, figure aussi parmi les objectifs. Cette liaison s’inscrit dans la dynamique de la Zone de libre-échange continentale africaine, destinée à développer le commerce entre les pays du continent. La mise en œuvre de cette phase associe notamment la Banque africaine de développement, le ministère de l’Économie et des Finances et le Bureau des Nations unies pour les services d’appui aux projets. Une enveloppe de 57,66 millions d’unités de compte est prévue pour quarante activités confiées à cette dernière institution. Les effets économiques dépendront de l’exécution des travaux et de leur impact réel sur les coûts de transport et la circulation des marchandises. Fanilo Mampianintsoa
